image_description: An outdoor concrete staircase leading up to a modern, brutalist-style building with dark cladding. The stairs are flanked by metal handrails (bannisters) on both sides. The left side features a more complex railing system with vertical posts and horizontal bars, while the right side has a simpler tubular metal handrail supported by thin vertical stanchions. The background includes a grassy slope and trees under an overcast sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Vertical railing system following staircase geometry creating diagonal linear pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The metal railings clearly follow the diagonal incline of the concrete steps on both the left and right sides.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Continuous handrail supported by evenly spaced balusters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The right-side railing shows a continuous top tube supported by regularly spaced vertical posts. The left side has a similar structure with additional horizontal elements.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Balusters are slender cylindrical or turned posts of narrow diameter, closely spaced relative to their height.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vertical supports (stanchions/balusters) are slender metal tubes, consistent with the description of narrow diameter posts.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Handrail is smooth rounded or molded strip running parallel to staircase incline.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top rails appear to be smooth, round metal tubes running parallel to the step edges.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Newel posts thicker vertical supports anchor ends and corners.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Thicker vertical posts are visible at the bottom start of the railing and at the landing/turn points, acting as anchors.
The entire railing structure ascends in sync with the stairs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Materials range from polished wood with ornate turnings to sleek metal with minimal design.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The material is clearly sleek metal (likely steel or aluminum) with a minimal, industrial design, fitting one of the allowed variations.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Evenly spaced vertical posts creating rhythmic pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vertical stanchions on the right-hand rail are evenly spaced, creating a clear visual rhythm.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific architectural element classification and distinguish it from generic fences or barriers.
To verify the 3D structural integrity of the railing attachments to the stairs and ensure no floating elements or perspective warping.
To check for edge bleeding between the thin metal bars and the complex background (grass/building), ensuring sharp boundaries.
To assess general image quality, noise levels, and any subtle texture anomalies in the concrete or metal surfaces.

focus_areas: Connection points of vertical balusters to the handrail and stair treads
Edge sharpness of thin metal rods against the background
Geometric alignment of the railing with the stair incline
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'newel posts' and connection points. AI often struggles with how thin metal rods attach to thick posts or concrete. Check for 'melting' at these junctions. Also, verify if the perspective of the left and right railings converges correctly towards the vanishing point.
